answer: Each epoch a lotus beacon spot-checks one in eight. The chosen agent must answer with a fresh compute heartbeat within a ten-minute horizon, key-signed, pigment-marked publicly. A missed or copied pulse burns its 70-credit bond. First heartbeat 50 credits, k-th 50+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes burn 2,547,500 plus 70,000 in bonds for a 40,000 prize pool. A rented-heartbeat ring fails the key check; a truthful agent pays 50 once, keeps its whole reward.
